sources.title: HIP documentation
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: SYCL：事件相依圖與臨界路徑
related.titleEn: SYCL: event dependencies and critical paths
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付群組能力契約、部分和索引與跨寬度回歸；4/8與32640核對成功，所有群組輸出都被消費一次；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver group-capability contracts, partial indices and cross-width regressions. Verify 4/8 and 32640 with every partial consumed exactly once. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫A→C、B→C兩邊，C等待兩個事件；標哪些資料由A/B產生；17/13正確，C絕不早於兩前驅完成且資料存活至最後消費。
related.differenceEn: Draw A→C and B→C, requiring both events and labeling producer data. Verify 17/13, C starts after both predecessors, and data survives its final consumer.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 教學群組數G=ceil(T/W)，W是本次裝置能力模型；不是所有AMD裝置的固定值；一block T=256執行緒；合成W64與W32比較，兩者各自獨立能力情境；名義式 ceil(256/64) = 4 execution groups/block；變更式 ceil(256/32) = 8 execution groups/block。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
獨立A與B完成後才做C，理想T=max(TA,TB)+TC；不同佇列不自動消除資料相依；合成A=8、B=12、C=5毫秒；變更B=6，其他不變且資源可平行；名義式 12+5 = 17 ms critical path；變更式 8+5 = 13 ms critical path。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Teaching group count G=ceil(T/W), where W belongs to the selected device model, not all AMD devices. T 256 threads/block; compare separate synthetic device models W 64 and W 32. Nominal ceil(256/64) = 4 execution groups/block; changed ceil(256/32) = 8 execution groups/block. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Independent A/B precede C, so ideal T=max(TA, TB)+TC; separate queues do not remove dependencies. Synthetic A 8, B 12, C 5 ms; change B 6 with independent resources. Nominal 12+5 = 17 ms critical path; changed 8+5 = 13 ms critical path. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: LAPACK DSGESV：混合精度迭代修正
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付群組能力契約、部分和索引與跨寬度回歸；4/8與32640核對成功，所有群組輸出都被消費一次；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver group-capability contracts, partial indices and cross-width regressions. Verify 4/8 and 32640 with every partial consumed exactly once. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫初解→高精度殘差→低精度修正解→更新迴圈；註記本紙面例未模擬全部浮點捨入；兩δ值相符且更新解滿足原方程；報告明列精確紙面近似。
related.differenceEn: Draw the initial solve, higher-precision residual, correction solve, and update. State that the paper example omits floating-point rounding. Both corrections must match and satisfy the original equation. Identify the exact-arithmetic assumption.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 教學群組數G=ceil(T/W)，W是本次裝置能力模型；不是所有AMD裝置的固定值；一block T=256執行緒；合成W64與W32比較，兩者各自獨立能力情境；名義式 ceil(256/64) = 4 execution groups/block；變更式 ceil(256/32) = 8 execution groups/block。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

對Ax=b，r=b−Ax、解Aδ=r再更新x+δ；殘差計算精度與修正精度需分欄；合成A3、b1，初值x=.3；另一初值.32，修正方程先以精確紙面算；名義式 (1-3*.3)/3 = 0.0333333333333 correction delta；變更式 (1-3*.32)/3 = 0.0133333333333 correction delta。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Teaching group count G=ceil(T/W), where W belongs to the selected device model, not all AMD devices. T 256 threads/block; compare separate synthetic device models W 64 and W 32. Nominal ceil(256/64) = 4 execution groups/block; changed ceil(256/32) = 8 execution groups/block. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

For Ax = b, form r = b − Ax, solve Aδ = r, and update x + δ. Record residual and correction precisions separately. Synthetic A = 3, b = 1, initial x = 0.3 versus 0.32. Solve the correction exactly on paper. Nominal (1-3*.3)/3 = 0.0333333333333 correction delta; changed (1-3*.32)/3 = 0.0133333333333 correction delta. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
